how_this_file_works: This catalog is the ONLY place the pipeline learns about source books. docs/content-factory/source-catalog.md mirrors it for humans and a unit test keeps them in sync.
chapter_url_template uses {nn} = zero-padded 2-digit chapter number, and {code} = the book code's {ps} placeholder for prelims.
ingest downloads the prelims PDF first, extracts the class-evidence string and the table of contents, then downloads the listed chapter numbers.
A 404 on a chapter of a books entry with chapters_verified=true is a FATAL error (fix the catalog).

A 404 on a chapter of an entry with chapters_verified=false ends that book's chapter list at the last successful chapter, records the fact in the run artifacts, and prints it loudly. This is the ONE sanctioned discovery behaviour, because NCERT books simply end; it is never silent.
ingest verifies the class-evidence string appears in the prelims text and fails loudly if it does not.
Entries with download: manual are not fetched. The pipeline tells you exactly which file to place at which path, and stops.
